phase-plan.purpose: Extract action availability and perform/execute branches out of `game.ts`, while also moving entity creation and canonical stat access into dedicated seams so `GameEngine` stops carrying legacy entity-shape responsibilities and the new runtime seams speak in stat-domain language.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: navigation, social, combat, inventory, and rune-forge action-family module boundaries; entity factory extraction; canonical stat helper adoption; runtime `narrativeStatDelta` action seams; removal of deprecated public stat fields from `EntityState`. Out of scope: event/progression/history extraction and gameplay rule rewrites.

file.description: Current action dispatch, availability, and perform/execute branches still live here and should be split by action family.
Fresh helper seam from 62-01 that action modules should import instead of reintroducing local utility logic.
Canonical entity stat helper seam for combat/narrative/rune map access. Action modules should use this instead of reviving `attributes`, `traits`, or `features` reads.
Entity creation has been pulled out of `game.ts` and should continue expanding until bootstrap is composition only.
Architecture doc already records the target action-family boundaries and should stay aligned with actual extraction progress.

task.description: Canonical stat migration and public entity-shape cleanup: remove deprecated `traits` / `features` / `attributes` / `health` / `energy` / `runeAffinities` from `EntityState`, add stat helpers, and move runtime consumers onto canonical maps.

Extract `performAction`, `availabilityForAction`, and the related `execute*` orchestration for navigation/social/combat/inventory/rune-forge families into dedicated modules, building on the new stat/entity seams.

Close the remaining 62-02 gap with parity coverage, residual `game.ts` cleanup, and documenting the new `narrativeStatDelta` / item `narrativeStatDelta` runtime seam before moving on to event/progression/history extraction.

decision.summary: Action availability should move before deeper execute/perform branches because it is easier to isolate and gives each action family a clear contract boundary.
decision.impact: Reduces the risk of breaking turn resolution while the first action modules are introduced.

decision.summary: Canonical stat migration has to land before the action-family split goes far, otherwise every extracted module keeps inheriting the dead `EntityState` surface and `game.ts` never stops being the compatibility sink.
decision.impact: New action modules can now target `combatStats`, `narrativeStats`, and `runeStats` directly instead of carrying transitional legacy field assumptions forward.

decision.summary: The extracted runtime seams should carry one `narrativeStatDelta` payload instead of continuing to push `traitDelta`/`featureDelta` deeper into engine code. Split views can remain at record/history boundaries until later cleanup.
decision.impact: New action modules are easier to reason about, runtime item payloads stop using `traitDelta`, and a later stat-language cleanup can target the remaining historical/content surfaces without reintroducing the split into new code.
